# OverviewCell

One figure in a row of figures, with a status dot and a label above it.

## Anatomy

A label line — dot, then mono text — over the figure in the display face. An optional rule divides it from the cell before.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` *(required)* | `string` | — | — |
| `value` *(required)* | `string \| number` | — | — |
| `color` | `string` | `'var(--text-primary)'` | A semantic colour token reference for the leading dot. |
| `state` | `string` | — | The word the dot's colour stands for, so the state is not carried by colour alone. |
| `divider` | `boolean` | `false` | Draws the rule that separates this cell from the one before it. |
| `pulse` | `boolean` | `false` | — |

## Variants

`divider` for every cell after the first.

## States

Static, pulsing.

## Keyboard

Not interactive.

## ARIA

The dot is decorative; passing `state` adds the word it stands for as visually hidden text, so the colour is never the only carrier.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.
